notes:
Use any AI key, fairer judging, and the mascot stays on top

- Works with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini or OpenRouter keys. Balanced is now the default.
- Fairer judging: it gives the benefit of the doubt when the work purpose is clear, allows research sites for study sessions, and can allow a tool like Slack for the whole session.
- Asking for time: typing pauses the countdown, and after a no you get the full time again to add detail (up to 3 asks). It says what detail would get it approved.
- Repeat warnings count down 5 seconds, longer if you've already explained.
- The mascot no longer disappears behind other windows, and on Windows walks to the tab's real close button.
- Mac: no longer gives up on a blocked tab when its address can't be read for a moment.
- The app window no longer shows an old version's page after an update.
